# group.typed.fmri_group_lm { #fmrimod.group.typed.fmri_group_lm }

```python
fmri_group_lm(
    data,
    *,
    intercept_only=True,
    formula=None,
    design_matrix=None,
    subjects=None,
    contrasts=None,
    space=None,
    n_jobs=1,
    chunk_size=None,
    covariates=None,
    mask=None,
)
```

Fit a group-level / second-level GLM.

Closes the typed-spec gap between the first-level
(`fmrimod.fmri_lm`) and group-level stages of the
modeling pipeline.

Headline shape:

```python
# n_subjects x n_voxels per-subject contrast betas
result = fm.fmri_group_lm(betas)
result.t_stat()       # (n_voxels,) one-sample group t map
result.effect()       # (n_voxels,) group-mean effect
result.p_value()      # (n_voxels,) two-sided p map
```

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name           | Type                                                                                | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | Default    |
|----------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| data           | Union\[NDArray\[np.floating\], GroupDataset, Mapping\[str, Any\], Sequence\[Any\]\] | Either:  - ``(n_subjects, n_voxels)`` numpy array of per-subject   contrast values (the common case — wrap into a   `GroupDataset` internally). - A `GroupDataset` for users who already have the   full sample × subject × contrast layout. - A mapping ``{subject_id: ContrastResult}`` (or a list of   ``ContrastResult``, named by ``subjects=``) straight from   first-level ``fit.contrast(...)`` calls; lowered with   `fmrimod.group_dataset_from_contrasts`, which also   carries each subject's standard errors. - A list of per-subject effect maps: NIfTI paths, nibabel images   or neuroim volumes (as Nilearn's ``SecondLevelModel.fit``).   Voxels are those in ``mask=`` (default: finite and non-zero in   every map), and the result can be written back with   `GroupLmResult.to_nifti`. | _required_ |
| intercept_only | bool                                                                                | Default ``True`` — the canonical one-sample group t test (``formula="~ 1"``). Mutually exclusive with ``formula=`` and ``design_matrix=``.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | `True`     |
| formula        | Optional\[str\]                                                                     | Optional R-style design formula (e.g. ``"~ group + age"``). Mutually exclusive with ``intercept_only=True`` and ``design_matrix=``.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | `None`     |
| design_matrix  | Optional\[Any\]                                                                     | Optional explicit design matrix or DataFrame; predictor column names become the keys for `GroupLmResult.effect`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | `None`     |
| subjects       | Optional\[Sequence\[Any\]\]                                                         | Subject ids when wrapping a raw array. Defaults to ``"sub-{i:02d}"`` strings.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | `None`     |
| contrasts      | Optional\[Sequence\[Any\]\]                                                         | First-level contrast names. Defaults to ``("contrast_0", "contrast_1", ...)``.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | `None`     |
| space          | Optional\[VoxelSpace\]                                                              | Optional explicit `VoxelSpace` when wrapping a raw array. Defaults to a dense voxel space with shape ``(n_voxels, 1, 1)`` and identity affine.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | `None`     |
| n_jobs         | int                                                                                 | Forwarded to `ols_voxelwise`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | `1`        |
| chunk_size     | int                                                                                 | Forwarded to `ols_voxelwise`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | `1`        |
| covariates     | Optional\[Any\]                                                                     | Subject-level table for ``formula=``: a DataFrame or the path of a TSV/CSV file such as a BIDS ``participants.tsv`` (``n/a`` read as missing). Rows are joined to subjects by id (``subject`` or ``participant_id`` column, ``sub-`` prefix optional). Subject ids come from ``subjects=``, the mapping keys, or the ``sub-<label>`` in map file names; only when none of those exist are rows taken in input order.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | `None`     |
| mask           | object                                                                              | Image-map input only: brain mask (path, image or boolean array).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | `None`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type          | Description                                                                                               |
|--------|---------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | GroupLmResult | Typed wrapper exposing ``.effect()``, ``.t_stat()``, ``.p_value()``, ``.standard_error()`` per predictor. |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

One-sample group t in one line:

```python
result = fm.fmri_group_lm(per_subject_betas)
t_map = result.t_stat()
```

Straight from first-level fits (subject id -> ``ContrastResult``):

```python
per_subject = {
    sub: fm.fmri_lm(spec, ds).contrast("face - house")
    for sub, ds in datasets.items()
}
t_map = fm.fmri_group_lm(per_subject).t_stat()
```

Two-group comparison with covariate:

```python
import pandas as pd
design = pd.DataFrame({"group": [0,0,0,1,1,1], "age": [...]})
result = fm.fmri_group_lm(
    per_subject_betas,
    intercept_only=False,
    design_matrix=design,
)
group_effect = result.effect("group")
group_t = result.t_stat("group")
```
